title: Borrower Document Milestone Status and Communication Update
subtitle: A controlled status update for the secure receipt, classification, version control, quality review, discrepancy routing, payment evidence, retention, and handoff of borrower-supplied documents without using the form as a repository for sensitive source material, carrying the record from secure identity and evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, customer communication, and accountable closeout.
description: Original high-value Borrower Document workflow for the secure receipt, classification, version control, quality review, discrepancy routing, payment evidence, retention, and handoff of borrower-supplied documents without using the form as a repository for sensitive source material. It is designed to record the current stage and objective evidence, preserve a milestone trail, expose blockers and revised dates, document customer communications, assign next actions, and hand off unresolved work while minimizing sensitive data and preserving a defensible evidence trail.
use_case: Use when a loan documentation coordinator must record the current stage and objective evidence, preserve a milestone trail, expose blockers and revised dates, document customer communications, assign next actions, and hand off unresolved work for one borrower document package. Closure requires a supported outcome, secure evidence references, customer or recipient communication, disposition of every exception, and an accountable handoff.

sections.title: Borrower Document status update identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, use secure references, and assign an accountable qualified owner before collecting or changing financial information.

blocks.label: Borrower Document record and responsible parties
Milestone Status and Communication Update timing and route
Secure-record boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter Social Security numbers, login credentials, full account or routing numbers, full credit-report contents, authentication secrets, or source documents here. Store sensitive evidence only in the approved system and record its secure reference.

sections.title: Borrower Document facts and evidence for status update
sections.guidance: Capture facts specific to this financial workflow, distinguish stated from verified information, and leave an evidence route for every material conclusion.

blocks.label: Borrower Document transaction or account profile
Borrower Document evidence checkpoints
items: Each document has a type, owner or issuer, period, version, and receipt date
Page count, completeness, legibility, orientation, and scan quality are checked
Source channel and chain-of-custody events are traceable
Duplicate, superseded, corrected, and translated versions are distinguished
Names, dates, amounts, and account references are checked for internal consistency
Expiration, freshness, certification, signature, or notarization needs are routed
Unneeded sensitive data is redacted or rejected under approved procedure
Actual documents remain in the secure repository, not embedded in this tracker
blocks.guidance: Check only when the item is present, current, and linked. Describe limitations or contradictions in the exception record.

blocks.label: Borrower Document quantitative and source-evidence register
blocks.guidance: Use one row per material input or evidence item; preserve the source period and verification status.

blocks.label: Package purpose, requested evidence, delivery constraints, version history, translation or accessibility needs, and known document discrepancies

fields.label: Borrower Document context and evidence limitations

sections.title: Borrower Document status update analysis and control record
sections.guidance: Use the blocks below to record the current stage and objective evidence, preserve a milestone trail, expose blockers and revised dates, document customer communications, assign next actions, and hand off unresolved work. Preserve objective evidence, uncertainty, ownership, and due points.

blocks.label: Current stage, timing, and communication status
Borrower Document milestone and evidence history
Current blockers, dependencies, and revised commitments
Customer and internal status communication controls
items: Update distinguishes completed, pending, blocked, and unverified work
Dates are evidence-based estimates rather than unsupported promises
Customer-facing language avoids internal codes and unexplained conclusions
Required next action identifies the party, channel, and due point
Sensitive details are shared only through the approved recipient channel
Changed terms, instructions, identity, or risk are routed for reverification
Complaint, dispute, accommodation, or urgent harm is separately escalated
Communication delivery, receipt, failure, and follow-up are recorded

blocks.label: Plain-language status summary, cause of delay, next action, and confidence limits

sections.title: Borrower Document stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop processing when authority, identity, evidence, safety, legality, fairness, privacy, fraud, or financial-crime controls are unresolved. Record facts rather than unsupported conclusions.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: Document arrived through an unapproved or unverifiable delivery channel
Borrower, issuer, period, version, page count, or account reference conflicts
Document is illegible, incomplete, expired, altered, password locked, or corrupted
A duplicate or superseded version may be mistaken for the current record
Unneeded sensitive data is exposed beyond the approved access group
Authenticity, signature, certification, translation, or notarization needs review
A requested document may be unnecessary, disproportionate, or prohibited
Package status was changed without evidence or accountable review
Status cannot be supported by objective milestone evidence
A promised date, customer message, or system status conflicts with the record
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires an immediate protective action, named owner, qualified review route, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Milestone Status and Communication Update exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed
Qualified-review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, creditworthiness, regulatory duties, fraud, sanctions status, or professional conclusions. Follow current institution policy and applicable requirements; route legal, compliance, underwriting, fraud, tax, accounting, or other professional questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Borrower Document decision, conditions, and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the qualified decision separately from preliminary analysis, identify every condition, and prevent execution beyond the approved scope.

blocks.label: Milestone Status and Communication Update qualified decision
Borrower Document decision and execution conditions
items: Current stage and next action are supported by dated evidence
Customer-facing message avoids unsupported promises or conclusions
Required-document list matches the product, stage, and qualified review request
Current versions and secure repository references are unambiguous
Quality, consistency, freshness, and authenticity exceptions are dispositioned
Sensitive source documents remain access controlled and properly retained
Borrower follow-up lists only necessary missing or corrected items
Package release is blocked until the receiving reviewer accepts readiness
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up
Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, disclosures, notices, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Borrower Document record as a substitute for a required application, contract, disclosure, adverse-action notice, payment instruction, credit report, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Borrower Document completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, remaining limitations are visible, customer communication is traceable, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Milestone Status and Communication Update outcome and primary handoff
Borrower Document closeout evidence
items: Final document inventory identifies current and superseded versions
All accepted items have secure repository and chain-of-custody references
Missing, deficient, or unnecessary requests have final dispositions
Sensitive-data access and retention class are assigned
Receiving reviewer acknowledges package readiness or specific limitations
Any fee or payment evidence is reconciled without storing credentials
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.

blocks.label: Closure status, custody, and retention
